subject: natural/paektu
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset: natural wonder card in a historical atlas.
Create ONE landscape 3:2 natural-history field sketchbook page. The real named landscape is the subject; preserve its characteristic landforms and plausible scale. Vary foreground and depth according to the scene. Use loose visible graphite construction lines, fine quick sepia ink and parallel hatching, restrained uneven watercolour washes of ochre, grey-green and faded blue, with colour concentrated on the landform. Irregular unfinished vignette edges dissolve into bare subtly worn warm cream paper. A working observational landscape sketch, not a photograph, digital render, fantasy illustration or glossy travel poster. No border, binding, captions, labels, dates, signature, watermark or readable writing. No modern tourist infrastructure, generic explorer portrait or invented landmarks. Do not merge several incompatible viewpoints into one scene.
Named place: Paektu Mountain. Scene: View from a dark volcanic rim down to Paektu's deep blue Heaven Lake, bowl of rugged pale and dark crater walls, patches of snow in sheltered gullies and clouds above. No temple, modern steps, active lava or cartoon perfect crater circle.
